title: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
title_zh: 真实输入，真实输出：如果场景文本编辑只使用真实数据会怎样？

paragraphs.en: 总结：该研究提出仅用真实数据自配对训练的场景文本编辑方法TextRIRO，缓解合成到真实的域差距，并构建大规模长文本识别数据集。 Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training. However, recent approaches rely heavily on synthetic paired data and complex disentanglement strategies. They struggle to faithfully capture the diversity and complexity of natural scenes, often producing artifacts or hallucinations. In this work, we challenge the common practice and investigate whether STE can be driven by turning each real sample into its own paired supervision. Concretely, we explore multiple ways to disrupt the original image (e.g., Crop, Shuffle, Mask) to construct self-paired training data, and build a strong baseline (TextRIRO}) upon a conditional diffusion architecture. Our experiments show that combining character-column shuffling with image cropping (Shuffle&Crop) effectively destroys text semantics while preserving key style cues, enabling the model to learn editing behaviors directly from the real text image. With this concise yet real-oriented design, TextRIRO achieves promising performance in both accuracy and visual realism across real-world benchmarks, substantially mitigating the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Furthermore, we leverage TextRIRO to build TextRIRO-3M, a large-scale realistic dataset for long-text recognition by concatenating edited and original images. Experimental results show that training recognition models with TextRIRO-3M significantly improves recognition accuracy, demonstrating that TextRIRO provides highly useful training resources for downstream tasks. Overall, TextRIRO lifts STE to realistic, reliable, and widely applicable new levels. Code is available at https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：该研究提出仅用真实数据自配对训练的场景文本编辑方法TextRIRO，缓解合成到真实的域差距，并构建大规模长文本识别数据集。 场景文本编辑（Scene Text Editing, STE）旨在在保留原始风格的同时修改文本内容，在许多应用中具有重要的实用价值。 STE 通常需要编辑前后的配对图像来进行训练。 然而，近期的方法严重依赖合成配对数据和复杂的解耦策略。 这些方法难以忠实地捕捉自然场景的多样性和复杂性，常常产生伪影或幻觉。 在本工作中，我们挑战这一常见做法，研究是否可以通过将每个真实样本转化为自身的配对监督来驱动 STE。 具体而言，我们探索了多种破坏原始图像的方式（如裁剪、打乱、掩码）来构建自配对训练数据，并基于条件扩散架构构建了一个强大的基线（TextRIRO）。 我们的实验表明，将字符列打乱与图像裁剪相结合（Shuffle&Crop）能在保留关键风格线索的同时有效破坏文本语义，使模型能够直接从真实文本图像中学习编辑行为。 借助这一简洁而面向真实数据的设计，TextRIRO 在多个真实世界基准上的准确性和视觉真实性方面均取得了出色的表现，显著缓解了合成到真实的域差距。 此外，我们利用 TextRIRO 通过拼接编辑后图像与原始图像，构建了 TextRIRO-3M，一个面向长文本识别的大规模真实数据集。 实验结果表明，使用 TextRIRO-3M 训练识别模型能显著提升识别准确率，证明 TextRIRO 为下游任务提供了极具价值的训练资源。 总体而言，TextRIRO 将 STE 提升到了真实、可靠且广泛适用的新水平。 代码已发布于 https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO。
